data.explanation: This is an invoice for an order of toner and copy paper. The total is €156.91, including 19% VAT (USt). The letter contradicts itself: the text asks for payment by 13 May 2026, while the "Fälligkeitsdatum" says 20 May 2026. To be safe, pay by the earlier date, 13 May 2026, or ask the company which date applies. Transfer the amount to the IBAN shown and use BB-4471 as the payment reference. If this was a business purchase, keep the invoice for your records.
